meta.title: Add benchmark support to C++ transpiler tests
meta.body_summary: Add benchmark option to C++ transpiler to wrap main with profiling and record results; update rosetta checklist format with duration/memory columns.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit infrastructure addition merged immediately by author; no review or performance evidence required.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: This is a medium-sized addition across 7 files (868 lines), consistent with an infrastructure feature for benchmarking. The swift self-merge without review indicates a routine, low-risk change by a maintainer.

review_details.performance_claim: Enables benchmarking of C++ transpiler output (duration/memory recording), not a runtime speedup claim.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The agent delivered a complete, self-contained feature that was merged by the author without external validation, highlighting a process boundary where maintainer trust and no review needed are key.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance data required; the PR adds benchmarking capabilities, so verification would be manual.

core_change_summary.description: Added benchmark option flag (-benchmark) to C++ transpiler; when set, main() is wrapped with timing/memory measurement. Updated rosetta checklist format to include duration and memory columns. Recorded benchmark results for 100-doors-2 and regenerated its C++ output with the benchmark wrapper. Documentation updated.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The .bench file and updated .cpp contain the generated benchmark output; documentation reflects the new checklist format.
change_trajectory: Single commit adds benchmark support across transpiler code, tests, and documentation; regenerates example with benchmark results.

collaboration_trajectory: PR authored and merged by maintainer tamnd with assistance from OpenAI_Codex; no reviewer interaction.
